title: Lateness Record of a Pocketwire Advance Line in Late Fee Relief
content:
For the payroll-delay relief, the lateness record of the Pocketwire Advance line is read from its own activity. When the line carries at most one late fee in the twelve months before the handling date and at least 3 advances were disbursed on it in that window, 0.05 is added to the relief share; when it carries at most one late fee in that window but fewer than 3 advances were disbursed on it, 0.02 is added to the relief share; when it carries two or more late fees in that window, its lateness record adds nothing to the relief share. The relief share is the fraction of the late fee that the relief returns.

**The window.** A window of twelve months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date.

**What is counted.** The number of late fee entries booked on the line in the window, and the number of advances disbursed on the line in the window. Late fees are counted by entry, whatever their amounts.

## Truth table

| Late fees on the line in the window | Advances disbursed in the window | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 3 or more | 0.05 |
| 1 | 3 or more | 0.05 |
| 0 | Fewer than 3 | 0.02 |
| 1 | Fewer than 3 | 0.02 |
| 2 or more | Any number | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A line with a single late fee in the last twelve months and 5 advances in that window: 0.05.
- A line with a single late fee and 2 advances in the window: 0.02.
- A line with two late fees in the window and 9 advances: nothing, whatever the number of advances.
- A late fee booked thirteen months before the handling date lies outside the window and is not counted.
